summary: First iteration: comprehensive backend (pytest, 32 tests) + frontend (Playwright) testing of StoleBooks marketplace. 31/32 backend tests pass. Full E2E buyer flow (register -> browse -> product -> cart -> COD checkout -> buyer dash) verified. Legal pages, mobile hamburger, gradient announcement bar, hero, and all core APIs (auth, forgot/reset, books CRUD, AI suggest via Claude Sonnet 4.5, cart, wishlist, checkout Razorpay+COD, invalid signature verify, orders, invoice, admin coupons/announcements/complaints, universities, Cloudinary sign) all working. One real backend bug found: GET /api/ returns 404 due to route order in server.py.

minor.issue: Returns 404. In /app/backend/server.py, `@api.get('/')` is declared at line 997 AFTER `app.include_router(api)` at line 987. FastAPI ignores routes added to the router after it has been included. Move the `@api.get('/')` handler above line 987, OR move `app.include_router(api)` to the end of the file. Task spec explicitly required GET /api/ to return 200.

action_items: Fix GET /api/ 404 in /app/backend/server.py by moving `@api.get('/')` (line 997) ABOVE `app.include_router(api)` (line 987). Trivial one-line reorder.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1000 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth.py, books.py, orders.py, admin.py, integrations.py) for maintainability.

server.py: `@api.get('/')` at line 997 is registered AFTER `app.include_router(api)` at line 987 — silently dropped by FastAPI, hence the 404. This is a subtle bug pattern that can bite other routes if code is added after include_router.
server.py: In `/checkout` for RAZORPAY path, `rz_client.order.create` is a sync call inside an async function — should be run via `asyncio.to_thread` or use httpx to avoid blocking the event loop.
server.py: `verify_payment` uses sync `rz_client.payment.fetch` inside async — same blocking issue.
server.py: `/orders/{oid}/cancel` restores books to ACTIVE unconditionally, even if the item was SOLD via successful payment. Add a status check to only restore PENDING orders.
server.py: `wishlist/toggle` uses `payload['book_id']` without a Pydantic model — no input validation; will 500 on malformed body.
server.py: `_seed_if_empty` re-seeds only when users collection is empty. If admin/seller/buyer are ever deleted individually, seed won't restore; document or fix.
seed data can leave some books in SOLD state after test runs — I had to manually restore. Consider a lightweight `/api/admin/reset-books-to-active` (dev-only) or a make target.

rca of the issue: GET /api/ returns 404: In FastAPI, routes must be registered on the APIRouter BEFORE `app.include_router(router)` is called. In server.py, `app.include_router(api)` runs at line 987, but `@api.get('/')` decorator runs at line 997 (module import order). The root handler is attached to the router object but the router's routes were already snapshotted into the app at include time — the late-added route is invisible to the app. Reproduction: `curl https://stolebooks-dev.preview.emergentagent.com/api/` -> 404. Fix: move the `@api.get('/')` and its function above the `app.include_router(api)` call, OR move `include_router` to the very bottom of the file.
